symptom: The Windows wrapper could pass a project root with a stray quote and could report success after a materialize command failed.
whyGateMissed: String-shape checks did not execute the generated cmd script with a spaced path, and same-line percent expansion captured errorlevel before the command ran.
earliestDetection: Execute the generated Windows wrapper from a path containing spaces, inject a materialize failure, and assert both a nonzero exit and an unquoted project root.
